categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor parsing and key decoding in src/script/descriptor.cpp and src/key_io.cpp, which are central to descriptor wallet management.
categories.rationale: The PR optimizes extended key descriptor parsing by consolidating redundant Base58Check decodings and adding a lookup table for checksum calculation. Author benchmarks on a 20-of-20 Taproot multisig descriptor showed ParseDescriptor execution time dropping from 127,812 ns to 90,253 ns (~29.4% speedup, confirmed at 36.7% by a reviewer), providing concrete speedups for descriptor processing and wallet fuzz targets.
